claims.claim: Each exact observation starts an independent 30-second window. A synthetic queued-subject regression established that an earlier exhausted observation does not exhaust the later subject's window.

Successful exact-SHA fetches are reused within one disposable observation. Synthetic regressions established independent retrieval across observations and fresh mutable-ref reads at existing lineage barriers.
The 30-second observation, 15-second Git-operation and 10-second API-operation ceilings remain enforced. Unavailable, malformed, moved, conflicting and exhausted observations fail closed to UNKNOWN.
Both delivery entries provide an in-job follow-up drain with at most two passes and a 15-second interval under the existing five-minute timeout. Held subjects remain durable.

Synthetic regressions established identical direct/fallback identity, one submission across concurrent follow-ups and a later drain, retained FIFO work and no resend of AMBIGUOUS attempts. Drain rechecks stop after submission or an ambiguity hold.
Schedule remains optional best-effort recovery. The changes introduce no write permission, dispatch mechanism, secret, daemon, polling service, semantic retry authority or ChatGPT Work dependency.
Event schemas and identity, publication classification and PublicationReport semantics, canonical supersession rules, browser/privacy guards and semantic-routing boundaries remain unchanged.

The conformance document records replay 37083846294, artifact 11260375137, identical direct/fallback identity, CANONICAL_UNKNOWN receipts, non-guaranteed schedule cadence and separate Human/Brain reconciliation of already-handled subjects before live wake proof. It makes no H4A5 closure or H4B readiness claim.
